microtheory.name: religion_theology
microtheory.definition: Religion + theology. World religious traditions (Abrahamic: Judaism, Christianity, Islam; Dharmic: Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, Sikhism; Daoism, Confucianism, indigenous + folk traditions). Theology, philosophy of religion, religious studies, comparative religion. Eliade, Otto, James, Smart. Substrate analogue: the discipline of meaning-systems involving the sacred, transcendence, ultimate concerns.

concepts.name: religion
concepts.definition: Complex of beliefs + practices + community + experience oriented toward sacred or ultimate. Many definitions; Geertz: 'system of symbols establishing powerful + persistent moods'.

concepts.name: sacred_profane
concepts.definition: Eliade. Sacred = set apart, charged with power; profane = ordinary. Hierophany = sacred manifests.

concepts.name: theology
concepts.definition: Systematic study of divine + religious doctrine. From within tradition (constructive) or critical (philosophical).

concepts.name: religious_studies
concepts.definition: Comparative + descriptive study from outside any single tradition. Phenomenology of religion. Smart's seven dimensions.

concepts.name: philosophy_of_religion
concepts.definition: Philosophical analysis of religious claims, arguments, experience. Arguments for/against God's existence, problem of evil, faith + reason.

concepts.name: judaism
concepts.definition: Abrahamic monotheism. Hebrew Bible (Tanakh) + Talmud. Covenant + Torah + chosen people. Substrate analogue: substrate's covenantal-relational framework.

concepts.name: christianity
concepts.definition: Abrahamic monotheism centered on Jesus of Nazareth as Christ. New Testament. Trinity, incarnation, atonement. Catholic + Orthodox + Protestant branches.

concepts.name: islam
concepts.definition: Abrahamic monotheism. Submission to Allah. Quran, Hadith, Five Pillars (shahada, salat, zakat, sawm, hajj). Sunni + Shia.

concepts.name: hinduism
concepts.definition: Dharmic family of traditions from Indian subcontinent. Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita. Karma, dharma, samsara, moksha. Many gods or one (Brahman).

concepts.name: buddhism
concepts.definition: Founded by Siddhartha Gautama ~5th c BCE. Four Noble Truths, Eightfold Path. Theravada, Mahayana, Vajrayana. No-self (anatta), impermanence.

concepts.name: daoism
concepts.definition: Chinese. Laozi, Zhuangzi. Dao (way) as ineffable source. Wu wei (non-action). Yin-yang balance.

concepts.name: confucianism
concepts.definition: Kongzi (Confucius). Ethics, social order, ritual propriety (li), benevolence (ren), filial piety. Often classified as philosophy not religion.

concepts.name: indigenous_religion
concepts.definition: Pre-modern, often pre-literate, place-based traditions. Animism, shamanism, ancestor veneration. Highly diverse globally.

concepts.name: god
concepts.definition: Concept of supreme being. Monotheistic (one), polytheistic (many), pantheistic (everything), panentheistic (everything + beyond).

concepts.name: monotheism
concepts.definition: One God. Judaism, Christianity, Islam. Logically distinct from monolatry (worship of one among many).

concepts.name: polytheism
concepts.definition: Many gods. Greek, Roman, Hindu (in some readings), Norse, Yoruba.

concepts.name: pantheism
concepts.definition: God = universe. Spinoza. Distinguished from panentheism (God includes but transcends universe).

concepts.name: atheism
concepts.definition: Absence of belief in gods. Weak (lack of belief) vs strong (active denial).

concepts.name: agnosticism
concepts.definition: Suspension of judgment on God's existence. T.H. Huxley coined.

concepts.name: myth
concepts.definition: Sacred narrative providing model. Eliade: in illo tempore — sacred time. Lévi-Strauss: structural analysis.

concepts.name: ritual_religious
concepts.definition: Patterned symbolic action with religious significance. Sacrament, prayer, sacrifice, pilgrimage.

concepts.name: mystical_experience
concepts.definition: Direct unmediated experience of ultimate. James's varieties: ineffable, noetic, transient, passive. Stace's introvertive vs extrovertive.

concepts.name: prayer
concepts.definition: Communication with divine. Petition, thanksgiving, confession, contemplation, intercession.

concepts.name: scripture
concepts.definition: Sacred text. Tanakh, Bible, Quran, Vedas, Tripitaka, Tao Te Ching. Often considered revelation.

concepts.name: revelation
concepts.definition: Disclosure from divine. Special (specific texts/events) vs general (nature, conscience).

concepts.name: ontological_argument
concepts.definition: Anselm. From concept of God as greatest conceivable being, existence follows. Gaunilo objected; many revisions.

concepts.name: cosmological_argument
concepts.definition: From cause/contingency. Aquinas's Five Ways. Kalam version: universe began, requires cause.

concepts.name: teleological_argument
concepts.definition: From design. Paley's watchmaker. Modern: fine-tuning. Hume + Darwin critique.

concepts.name: problem_of_evil
concepts.definition: How reconcile God's goodness + power with evil? Free will defense, soul-making theodicy, skeptical theism, process theology. Atheist's strongest argument.

concepts.name: faith_and_reason
concepts.definition: Tertullian (against), Aquinas (compatible), Kierkegaard (faith beyond reason). Tension central to philosophical theology.

concepts.name: secularization
concepts.definition: Decline of religious authority in modernity. Weber. Disputed: religion persists + reinvents.

concepts.name: religious_pluralism
concepts.definition: Multiple traditions valid. Hick. Vs exclusivism + inclusivism.

concepts.name: fundamentalism
concepts.definition: Strict adherence to perceived fundamentals + literalist reading. 20th-c phenomenon across traditions.

concepts.name: liberation_theology
concepts.definition: Latin American. Gustavo Gutiérrez. Christianity engaged with structural poverty + injustice.

rules.name: religious_traditions_have_internal_diversity
rules.head: Jabberwock examines a religious tradition
rules.body: internal variation (Sunni/Shia, Theravada/Mahayana, Catholic/Protestant) often equals or exceeds variation between traditions. Substrate's no-monolith principle.

rules.name: sacred_set_apart_from_profane
rules.head: Jabberwock observes religious practice
rules.body: Eliade: religious phenomena involve setting apart the sacred from the profane through ritual, space, time, person. Substrate's category-protected pattern.

rules.name: problem_of_evil_is_central_challenge
rules.head: Jabberwock examines monotheistic theology
rules.body: reconciling all-good + all-powerful God with observed evil is the persistent + strongest challenge. Theodicy attempts the answer.

rules.name: religious_experience_resists_full_propositional_capture
rules.head: Jabberwock examines mystical reports
rules.body: James: experience ineffable + noetic. Conceptual analysis essential but incomplete. Substrate's experiential-vs-propositional knowledge.

rules.name: rituals_constitute_communities
rules.head: Jabberwock observes religious community
rules.body: shared ritual practice constitutes community identity beyond shared belief. Durkheim's collective effervescence.
